name: Fix The Hoof 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Fix The Hoof is a relaxing simulation game where you step into the role of a hoof specialist, cleaning and restoring the hooves of animals like horses, cows, and goats. Experience the most satisfying ASMR moments as you clean, polish, and paint hooves in this immersive 3D game.
